children: Satellite maker Aerospacelab has secured a €2.4 billion contract to build 264 satellites for the European Union's IRIS² secure communications constellation, the Belgian company said on Thursday.

The contract gives Aerospacelab responsibility for around 76% of the network's planned 348 satellites, making it one of the biggest industrial beneficiaries of the EU bloc's flagship connectivity programme.
